# Homesrolo

> Homesrolo helps homeowners understand major home projects and keep a durable record of work performed on a property. Public guides are independent education. Private homeowner files are separate and are never published by these pages.

## Roofing

- [Texas roofing center](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/): Cost, materials, contractor checks, insurance boundaries, and Dallas Fort Worth rules.
- [Roof replacement cost](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/cost/): Dallas market benchmarks and a line-by-line estimate comparison.
- [Roofing materials](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/materials/): Asphalt, impact-resistant, metal, tile, slate, composite, and the full roof assembly.
- [Contractor checklist](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/choose-a-contractor/): Documents to verify and 12 questions to ask before signing.
- [Dallas Fort Worth roofing](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/dfw/): North Texas weather, local rules, and project records.
- [Dallas roofing](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/dallas/): Dallas roofing permits, bids, and closeout records.
- [Fort Worth roofing](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/fort-worth/): Fort Worth permit triggers, wood repairs, and scope details.

## Trust and method

- [About Homesrolo](https://homesrolo.com/about/)

## Important limits

- Homesrolo does not inspect roofs, price individual jobs, select a contractor, or advise on an insurance claim.
- Cost figures are dated market benchmarks, not quotes for a particular home.
- Permit rules and laws can change. The current source is linked from each guide.
- The current public company pages are clearly labeled samples and are blocked from search indexing. A real contractor directory is not live yet.
